name: jamf-mcp
description: Jamf inventory, device troubleshooting and compliance workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Jamf inventory, device reports and compliance.
interface.longDescription: Jamf workflows for ChatGPT and Codex. The local package starts a stdio server with writes disabled. Live validation covers read-only workflows; tenant access needs separately configured credentials.
defaultPrompt: Check Jamf setup status through this plugin.
List computers with names and serial numbers.
Investigate DDM status for a Jamf-managed computer.
Assess a Jamf Platform compliance benchmark.
